notes.title: "Departed Away" Development Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44591813/600c64353beb8318224952d188ce7347310e4b39.png[/img]

Hey there, fellow gamers and visual novel enthusiasts,

I'm super excited to give you the lowdown on my game, "Departed Away." So, here's the scoop:

✅ Game Progress: 60%
First off, "Departed Away" is now 60% complete! I've been working my tail off to make sure it's a memorable experience.

✨ Visual Novel Routes Progress:

Hitomi: 80% Complete
Marcel: 80% Complete
Class Sessions: 80% Complete
Veronica: 40% Complete
Beatrice: 50% Complete
I've put my heart and soul into these routes, and I can't wait for you to dive in.

📅 Release Date: December
Okay, here's the kicker: I'm pushing the release date to December. I know, I know, it was supposed to be in October, but my college workload got in the way. Thanks for being understanding about that!

I want to give a massive shoutout to you all for your support and patience. Keep your eyes peeled for more updates, and mark your calendars for the December release. Can't wait to introduce you to the "Departed Away" world!

See ya,
Alperen Torun a.k.a Nooarth

notes.title: Development Update for "Departed Away"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44591813/5a99333faf44f7b056df5e0b8b373d0056510f9b.png[/img]

Dear Departed Away Lovers,

I wanted to give you an update on the progress of "Departed Away," a project I've been working tirelessly on since June 15th – that's almost four months of hard work.

The development phase has had its fair share of challenges. Life threw some unexpected curveballs my way, leading to four one-week breaks, totaling a month of downtime. But, as they say, setbacks often lead to better decisions.

Speaking of decisions, I've made the choice to change the game's name to better reflect its essence. This is all part of the natural evolution of the project.

Initially, I aimed for a September release, but unforeseen issues beyond my control forced me to push that timeline. I then set my sights on October, but it's clear that I won't be able to meet that deadline. As a gesture of appreciation for your patience, I've decided to include the second club in the demo.

In the coming days, I'll delve into the development journey more deeply, sharing the challenges I've faced and my plans moving forward. Your support has been my driving force, and I'm fully committed to delivering the best possible "Departed Away" experience.

Thank you for your understanding and unwavering support. I'm looking forward to sharing more with you soon.

Stay tuned for updates!

Warm regards,
Alperen Torun a.k.a Nooarth.

notes.title: "Departed Away" Simple Roadmap Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44591813/3d21512b8f6222276873c024e28542e0e2421069.png[/img]

1. Demo Drop: Sept 13-17, 2023
Save the date! From September 13th to the 17th, you'll get a sneak peek at "Departed Away." Play the demo and explore a taste of what's to come!

2. Demo Upgrade: Sept 18-24, 2023
Your feedback rocks! I'll be all ears during the demo phase. From September 18th to the 24th, I'll roll out an update based on your valuable input.

3. Full Game Launch: Late October 2023
I'm putting the finishing touches on "Departed Away" for a late October release. Get ready for the full adventure, packed with mysteries and stories to uncover.

Stay tuned for more updates and exciting news about "Departed Away." Don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam to be the first in the know!

Thanks for the support, guys. Since I have been working on this game on my own, I truly need your support.

Alperen Torun a.k.a Nooarth
